statement: The IBEX kernel haptic output path uses the HID handle owned by the slot's steam_device. SDL sends per-device rumble and lizard or IMU feature reports on the selected HIDAPI handle, with its periodic lizard/rumble work gated on an attached joystick. Neither code path establishes receiver-side acknowledgements, slot-address bytes, or a physical effect after a controller departs.

applicability.revision: pinned Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0 consumer source; retail hardware unmeasured
applicability.scope: Steam Controller 2026 Puck receiver consumer behavior; no physical or virtual host test
